# BunnyCDN

BunnyCDN is a powerful content delivery network (CDN) offering an API to manage and deliver content globally with ease.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bunnycdn/.

## Actions

- **Add Storage Zone**: Add a new storage zone.
- **Create DNS Record**: Create a new dns record in a specific dns zone.
- **Create Pull Zone**: Create a new pull zone.
- **Delete DNS Record**: Delete a specific dns record by its id.
- **Delete DNS Zone**: Delete a specific dns zone by its id.
- **Delete Pull Zone**: Delete a specific pull zone by its id.
- **Delete Storage Zone**: Delete a storage zone.
- **Get DNS Zone List** (read-only): List all dns zones in your bunny cdn account.
- **Get Pull Zone List** (read-only): Fetch the list of pull zones.
- **Get Storage Zone List** (read-only): List all storage zones in your bunny cdn account.
- **List DNS Records** (read-only): List all dns records in a specific dns zone.
- **Update Pull Zone**: Update settings for a specific pull zone.
- **Update Storage Zone**: Update settings for a specific storage zone.
- **Get DNS Zone Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific dns zone by its id.
- **Get Pull Zone** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific pull zone.
- **Get Storage Zone Details** (read-only): Retrieve the full details of a storage zone.
- **Get Storage Zone Region** (read-only): Retrieve the region code of a storage zone.
- **Purge Pull Zone**: Purge the entire cache of a pull zone.
- **Purge URL**: Purge a specific url from the bunnycdn cache.
- **Set Storage Zone Region**: Update replication regions of a storage zone.
